# Upstream paths cited in the skills that do NOT resolve in a current checkout.
#
# `scripts/verify-upstream-claims.py --upstream` sweeps every upstream-shaped path
# citation in the skill trees. A `path:line` citation is failed outright: either the
# file has that many lines or the citation drifted. A path-only citation is different
# — a skill legitimately names a file that is absent, and there is no heuristic that
# separates the legitimate cases from rot. Three kinds recur:
#
#   rename      the pre-rename side of a documented rename, kept so a reader can
#               recognise the old layout
#   nonexistent cited in order to state that it does not exist upstream, usually to
#               correct an earlier draft that assumed it did
#   created     a file the port is instructed to produce, which by definition is not
#               upstream yet
#
# So every unresolved path must be listed here with its kind and reason. The sweep
# fails on an unresolved path that is absent from this file, AND on an entry here
# that now resolves — a stale exemption is how a real regression gets waved through.
#
# One path per line: <path> | <kind> | <reason>

src/main/java/org/prebid/server/spring/config/bidder/AdopplerConfiguration.java | rename | adoppler was renamed to elementaltv; junit-it-patterns.md lists the pre-rename paths beside their post-rename targets so the cascade is legible.
src/test/java/org/prebid/server/it/AdopplerTest.java | rename | Same rename cascade; the post-rename ElementalTVTest.java is what exists.
static/bidder-params/adoppler.json | rename | Same rename cascade; elementaltv.json is what exists.
static/bidder-params/_schema.json | nonexistent | port-go2java's acceptance gates cite this path to record that it does NOT exist in upstream prebid-server-java, which validates via BidderParamValidator at runtime. Removing the citation would delete the correction.
static/bidder-info/_schema.json | nonexistent | port-java2go's acceptance gates cite this path to record that Go has NO bidder-info JSON schema; bidder-info YAML is validated by the validate* functions in config/bidderinfo.go and exercised by config/bidderinfo_test.go. The citation exists to correct a gate that told a porter to validate against this file.
